sovereign_country.strategic_role: 全球海事商船注册旗国、借鉴特拉华州公司法的非公开发行实体

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Tailoring of Licensed Theatrical Costume Robes and Synthetic Wigs

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid (statutory common-law tradition modeled on the Delaware General Corporation Law and U.S. common-law principles, with residual customary law recognized under the RMI Constitution)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Compact of Free Association (COFA) with the United States of America, as amended in 2003, including its Economic Relations Provisions
OACPS–European Union Partnership Agreement (Samoa Agreement), trade and development cooperation framework

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Business Corporations Act, Title 51 of the Marshall Islands Revised Code (as amended); Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorist Financing Act 2012 (as amended) and its implementing Regulations; Registered Agents and Trust Companies Act, Title 52; RMI Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU) Sanctions and AML Directive implementing United Nations and OFAC lists; RMI participation in the Asia/Pacific Group on Money Laundering (APG) with adherence to FATF Recommendations as domestically applicable.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified true copy of passport of each UBO, director, and authorized signatory
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Qualified notary public in the document holder's country of origin or residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (1961 Hague Apostille Convention, applicable to RMI); consular legalization only if issuing state is not an Apostille Convention member

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Proof of residential or business address of each UBO (utility bill or bank statement issued within the preceding 3 months)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Utility provider or issuing financial institution
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille on the notarized copy issued by the state competent authority

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Original bank reference letter confirming the banking relationship and standing of the applicant or UBO
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Retaining financial institution in the UBO's country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or authenticated signature of the bank's authorized officer, accepted at the registered agent's discretion

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Power of Attorney or certified shareholder/board resolution appointing the International Registered Agent and Constitutions
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Applicant shareholders or board of directors of the proposed entity
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille through the notary or competent authority of the jurisdiction of execution

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all identified UBOs, directors, officers, and authorized signatories against the OFAC SDN List, UN Security Council Consolidated List, UK HMT Sanctions List, EU Consolidated Sanctions List, Interpol notices, and the RMI FIU published sanctions list; automatic enhanced due diligence (EDD) for any PEP, immediate family member, or close associate, including source-of-funds and source-of-wealth verification; negative media and corporate ownership lookup; continuous transaction and relationship monitoring with mandatory re-screening at intervals not exceeding 90 days.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Marshall Islands Corporate Registry (Office of the Registrar of Corporations, operationally administered by International Registries, Inc.); name-clearance and incorporations are submitted exclusively through licensed International Registered Agents via the IRI electronic filing platform, with no direct public portal.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Corporate names must be rendered in the English/Latin alphabet; diacritics and non-Latin characters are not accepted; numerals, punctuation, and standard abbreviations are permitted; the name must be distinguishable upon the records from existing domestic entities and foreign-qualified entities; a non-Latin script name must be romanized into English, and the Certificate of Incorporation will issue in the English rendering.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon a name rejection notice, the licensed International Registered Agent may file a Request for Reconsideration with the Registrar of Corporations within 30 days of the rejection, submitting legal authority for the proposed name, a written explanation of the corporate purpose, and, for sensitive tokens, the relevant RMI ministry or regulatory consent; a further written appeal to the Registrar may be made within 60 days of an unfavorable reconsideration; final judicial review is available before the High Court of the Marshall Islands under Title 51 of the RMI Code. Practically, concurrent reservation of alternative acceptable names is recommended so the first available name is secured.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permitted. The RMI Business Corporations Act requires a statutory registered office and a licensed International Registered Agent located in the Republic; the registered agent's office serves as the registered office. A non-resident, low-risk e-commerce cosplay business may operate entirely remotely without physical premises in the RMI. Payment service providers such as Stripe and Shopify Payments may impose independent KYB, bank-account, and place-of-business verification requirements, and the registered agent's address may not be used as the principal trading address. An annual economic substance declaration may be required under the Non-Resident Domestic Entities (Economic Substance) Act 2019, which for the described remote-trading activity does not mandate physical premises in the RMI.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low, approximately 1%–2% annualized for a dormant or remotely operated non-resident Business Corporation in the Low_Risk_Standard tier. The RMI Registrar and FIU do not routinely conduct unannounced physical premises inspections of non-resident entities; supervision is primarily records-based through the registered agent. On-site inspection risk increases only in the event of a suspicious transaction report, FATF/APG mutual-evaluation follow-up action, or a targeted FIU compliance examination, in which case the registered agent's office in Majuro, rather than the applicant's foreign premises, would be the principal inspection point.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff, Title 51 of the RMI Code fee schedule

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark under the International Registered Agent fee schedule

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization, apostille/consular legalization, and English translation of KYC documents (per UBO document set)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: State notary tariff / 1961 Hague Apostille Convention fee

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Registrar of Corporations, Government of the Republic of the Marshall Islands
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff, Title 51 of the RMI Code fee schedule

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Registrar of Corporations / International Registries, Inc.

Company kit (minute book, share certificates, common seal if requested) and certified copies of Constitutions
Bank reference letter and professional reference verification for PSP onboarding (Stripe / Shopify Payments)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Originating financial institution or professional advisor

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Business Corporations Act 1990, Republic of the Marshall Islands, Title 51 of the Marshall Islands Revised Code; incorporation under §1.50, contents of Articles under §1.51, and registered agent requirements under §1.54.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Ministry of Justice, Republic of the Marshall Islands
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Articles of Incorporation (with Consent to Appointment of Registered Agent)
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital is prescribed for a non-resident Business Corporation; the authorised capital is fixed in the Articles, and no escrow account or paid-in funds are required at incorporation.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the Corporation hereby ratifies the subscription for and issuance of initial authorised shares as recorded in the Articles of Incorporation; adopts the registered office and registered agent designated by the incorporators for service of process; and elects the following officers to serve until their successors are duly appointed: Chief Executive Officer and Chief Financial Officer, and Secretary. RESOLVED FURTHER, that all officers and the registered agent are authorised to execute and deliver any consents, tax registrations, and statutory filings required by the laws of the Republic of the Marshall Islands. Adopted unanimously by the initial Board of Directors by written consent.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, RMI Corporations e-Filing Portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit an online name reservation application for the proposed corporate name, together with the reservation fee. Verify that the name is not identical or deceptively similar to any existing RMI corporation, limited partnership, or reserved name.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused, select up to three alternative names and resubmit the reservation application, or file a formal administrative objection with the Registrar within 15 business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation and Execution of Articles of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed RMI Registered Agent / Notary Public
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Articles of Incorporation containing the corporate name, registered agent name, registered office address, authorised share capital, and incorporator details. Execute the Articles before a notary public or licensed registered agent, and obtain a certified consent from the proposed registered agent.
required_dossiers: Articles of Incorporation, executed and notarised
Consent to Appointment of Registered Agent
Certified KYC/AML documentation of incorporators, directors, and officers
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar issues a deficiency notice, correct the identified sections, re-execute the Articles, and resubmit within 10 business days without an additional filing fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, RMI Corporations e-Filing Portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the executed Articles of Incorporation, registered agent consent, and payment of the official state filing fee via the e-filing portal or in person at the Registrar's office. Obtain a date-stamped acknowledgement of receipt and filing number.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the filing is rejected for incomplete statutory data, the applicant may cure and resubmit the same transaction within 10 business days; if rejection relates to fee insufficiency, pay the outstanding difference and obtain expedited review.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Registered Office and Registered Agent Designation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Ensure the registered agent is licensed in the Marshall Islands and the registered office is a physical address in Majuro. File the registered agent consent and address confirmation simultaneously with the Articles of Incorporation.
required_dossiers: Copy of registered agent's RMI license
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the nominated agent is not licensed, substitute a licensed registered agent and file an amended consent; the Registrar will process the replacement within 3 business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Incorporation Organizational Resolutions and Share Issuance
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After issuance of the Certificate of Incorporation, convene the first board meeting or obtain unanimous written consent. Adopt the by-laws, approve the pro-forma first board resolution, elect officers, and issue authorised shares to the subscriber in accordance with the Articles.
required_dossiers: First Board Meeting Minutes or Unanimous Written Consent
Share Subscription Agreement and Share Certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the organisational action is challenged for procedural deficiency, reconvene the board or obtain a ratified unanimous written consent to correct all defective acts.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: None — no industrial operating licence is statutorily required for ISIC 3240 tailoring of theatrical costume robes and synthetic wigs in the Marshall Islands.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Environmental Protection Authority, Republic of the Marshall Islands
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt — light manufacturing with no significant emissions; registration-only pathway
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater discharge must not exceed RMI national effluent standards; VOC emissions limited to 0.5 lb/hour from solvent-borne coatings; all synthetic wig fibre waste must be contained and disposed of through an approved municipal waste contractor.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certification and structural load clearance are issued by the Majuro Fire Department and Building Inspectorate for the proposed production premises; a workplace occupancy clearance is required before manufacturing activities begin.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Marshall Islands Revenue and Tax Administration (RTA), Ministry of Finance, Republic of the Marshall Islands, Majuro; statutory business licensing is administered separately by the Business License Office within the Office of the Attorney General. Filings are accepted in paper form by mail or in person; no online national tax filing portal is prescribed for exempt non-resident corporations.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: (1) Incorporate under the Business Corporations Act 1990 by filing Articles of Incorporation with the Registrar of Corporations (Office of the Associate Registrar) and appointing a registered agent; obtain the Certificate of Incorporation and corporate registration number. (2) Submit a Business License application to the Business License Office under the Business License Act 2006 for activity ISIC 3240, pay the annual license fee, and obtain the Business License number, which functions as the principal regulatory identifier. (3) No income tax TIN is issued because non-resident domestic business corporations are exempt from Marshall Islands income tax on non-island source income; the corporate number and business license number are accepted for customs and banking purposes. (4) If physical goods are exported from Marshall Islands territory, register with the Marshall Islands Customs Service and file export declarations under Title 21 of the Marshall Islands Revised Code.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: None applicable. The Marshall Islands does not operate a check-the-box regime, controlled-foreign-corporation rules, or hybrid mismatch election mechanism. Non-resident domestic business corporations are taxed on a strict territorial basis: income derived from sources outside the Marshall Islands is exempt by statute, and no income, capital gains, estate, gift, or withholding tax is imposed on such entities. No affirmative election is required to maintain the exempt status; the exemption is the default statutory classification.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: None. The Republic of the Marshall Islands levies no VAT, GST, or sales-and-use tax. The only indirect taxation is customs and excise duty imposed on imported goods under Title 21 of the Marshall Islands Revised Code (Customs and Excise Tax). Exports are outside the charge to duty and are not subject to any national indirect tax.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Not applicable. There is no VAT/GST registration regime, no economic turnover threshold, and no indirect tax registration obligation for domestic or foreign persons. Importers must, however, be registered with Customs for clearance of physical shipments, and a business license is required for any commercial activity regardless of turnover.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: None. No real-time fiscal clearance, government API e-invoicing, digital stamping, or certified invoicing infrastructure exists. Commercial invoices and packing lists are required as supporting documents for customs declarations, but they are not validated through any electronic fiscal clearance system.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Not applicable. There is no VAT on exports and therefore no zero-rating claim procedure. Goods exported from Marshall Islands territory are outside the customs duty base; no export sales levy arises. Imported inputs subsequently re-exported may qualify for a duty drawback under customs regulations, subject to a written re-export declaration and verification of the import entry.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Marshall Islands Customs entry form)
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill
Re-Export Declaration and underlying Import Entry (for duty drawback claims)
Certificate of Origin (when required by the destination country)
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The Marshall Islands imposes no currency controls and the U.S. Dollar is legal tender, so there is no statutory foreign-exchange repatriation deadline; the 180-day figure is a prudential compliance benchmark for documentary consistency in export/duty-drawback substantiation. False export declarations, under-declaration, misdescription of goods, or fraudulent drawback claims attract civil penalties up to USD 10,000, forfeiture of goods or bond, and imprisonment up to five years under Title 21 of the Marshall Islands Revised Code, together with revocation or suspension of the Business License under the Business License Act 2006. As no VAT exists, no retrospective VAT clawback or zero-rating fraud regime applies; customs duty evasion and drawback fraud are the analogous clawback risks.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Not applicable - the Republic of the Marshall Islands (RMI) has no central bank. The competent banking, AML, and foreign exchange supervisory authority is the Office of the Banking Commissioner within the Ministry of Finance of the Republic of the Marshall Islands. The United States dollar is the sole legal tender, with the U.S. Federal Reserve serving as the de facto currency issuer.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The RMI has no domestic non-convertible currency; the USD is fully convertible and freely transferable. Both current account and capital account transactions are unrestricted. Profit remittance, capital repatriation, dividend distribution, and shareholder loan repayments are not subject to exchange control approval or withholding by the RMI. The only practical hurdles are bank-level OFAC/AML screening, sanctions filter review, and the requirement to document the economic substance and beneficial ownership of the non-resident Business Corporation.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No statutory export proceeds surrender rules exist. There is no mandated timeline for repatriation, no compulsory conversion ratio, no central pool requirement, and no requirement to convert export receipts into any local currency. Export proceeds denominated in USD may be retained in overseas correspondent accounts, held in the RMI bank account, or reinvested without filing with the Banking Commissioner.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: Medium for ancillary collection and disbursement channels; Low as a primary treasury or settlement account. Offshore digital EMIs such as Wise Business and Airwallex are not licensed under the RMI Banking Act 2011 and do not provide Marshall Islands-based deposit accounts, domestic ACH access, or local account numbers. They may be used to collect e-commerce receivables from Stripe/Shopify Payments and to make selected vendor payouts, but all statutory capital injections and substantive trade settlements should be cleared through an RMI-licensed commercial bank and its USD correspondent network. Correspondent banks may apply enhanced scrutiny to EMIs if the EMI is used as the sole treasury route.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: RMI corporate law does not require directors to appear physically in the Marshall Islands. However, bank onboarding practice under the Banking Act 2011 and RMI AML/CFT rules generally requires at least one director and every natural person owning more than 10% of the entity to complete an interview, either physically at the bank, through a notarized agent, or via a bank-approved verified video link. Fully remote onboarding is rarely granted to a newly formed non-resident Business Corporation. A physical presence at the Majuro branch or a verified interview with a notarized documentary package is strongly recommended.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident Business Corporation with no local employees, no office, and perceived lack of economic substance in the RMI.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certificate of Incorporation; Certificate of Good Standing; registered agent certificate; corporate charter and bylaws; board resolution opening the account; local substance evidence such as office lease, utility bill, correspondence address, and local agent agreement; detailed business plan for cosplay prop and apparel manufacturing; shareholder register; group structure chart.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Cross-border e-commerce receivables from Stripe and Shopify Payments with high volume, refunds, and chargebacks, creating an atypical transaction pattern for a manufacturer.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Merchant account agreements with Stripe and Shopify Payments; periodic payout and settlement statements; customer order ledgers; refund and chargeback reporting; shipping and fulfillment records; customs declarations; product catalog; warehouse or third-party logistics contracts; end-customer invoices.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Licensed theatrical costume and cosplay product lines involving intellectual property rights, trademark, and character licensing, which may trigger IP infringement or royalty-flow red flags.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Valid licensing and merchandising agreements; IP owner authorization letters; trademark registration certificates; royalty schedules and payment ledgers; product design and manufacturing authorization records; attestation of non-infringement; indemnity insurance declarations.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Potential concealment of beneficial ownership through nominee directors, bearer shares, or an offshore parent structure.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Complete beneficial ownership register; passport copies of all directors and ultimate beneficial owners; statutory declarations confirming no bearer shares; corporate resolutions; source of funds and source of wealth documentation; shareholder loan agreements; independent legal opinion on the validity of the corporate structure; evidence of compliance with RMI Business Corporations Act and beneficial ownership filing requirements.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Capital injections should be routed through SWIFT MT103 / MT202 from the parent company or subscriber to the RMI Business Corporation's USD account at Bank of Marshall Islands or Bank Pacific, via a major U.S. correspondent bank using Fedwire or CHIPS. The payment instruction should identify the beneficiary as the RMI entity with its corporate registry number and should reference 'Shareholder Capital Contribution', 'Paid-in Capital', or 'Shareholder Loan' under the U.S. BOP classification for 'Direct investment: equity capital' or 'Other investment: loans'. No RMI exchange control permit is required. The bank's AML file must contain the board resolution authorizing the capital injection, share issuance records, the funding agreement, and source-of-funds statements from the remitting bank.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Trade settlements should use U.S. dollar-denominated clearing rails. For open-account supplier payments, SWIFT MT103 is dispatched through Bank of Marshall Islands or Bank Pacific to the beneficiary bank in the supplier's jurisdiction. For larger or documentary transactions, a commercial letter of credit (documentary LC) issued by the RMI bank and confirmed by a U.S., Hong Kong, or Singapore correspondent bank is appropriate, with payment against the presentation of shipping documents under FOB, CIF, or EXW terms. E-commerce refunds and platform payouts from Stripe and Shopify Payments settle in USD to the RMI operational account via the merchant's U.S. acquiring and clearing infrastructure. There is no domestic clearing system in the RMI; physical checks are cleared through U.S. image clearing correspondent arrangements.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable USD/CNY forward contracts with licensed international banks to hedge RMB-denominated supplier costs
Deliverable USD/EUR, USD/JPY, and USD/GBP forward contracts for European and Asian warehouse, freight, and equipment purchases
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) on CNY, KRW, and other restricted currencies where local deliverability is unavailable
Cross-currency swaps (USD/CNY and USD/EUR) for trade finance liabilities exceeding 12 months
FX options purchased from regulated dealers for tactical hedging of order-book receivables

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Report and Corporate Franchise Tax Return
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of Corporations, Republic of the Marshall Islands (Office of the Attorney General, Majuro; lodged through the licensed registered agent)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually on or before June 1 for the preceding calendar year; the statutory filing window opens January 1 each year.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: A late penalty of USD 200 per month or fraction of a month accrues for filings made after June 1. Continued delinquency across two consecutive annual-report cycles (or failure to cure a Registrar delinquency notice) triggers administrative dissolution and strike-off from the corporate register, extinguishing separate legal capacity.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Beneficial Ownership (UBO) Confirmation and AML/CFT Customer Due Diligence Refresh
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Licensed registered agent acting as the MLPA obligated person; regulatory oversight by the Marshall Islands Financial Intelligence Regulatory Authority (Banking Commissioner)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually within 30 days of the registered agent's refresh notice and in all cases before the June 1 annual report lodgment; the Marshall Islands MLPA requires ongoing customer due diligence monitoring on a rolling 12-month cycle.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to return the signed UBO confirmation within the agent's cure period (typically 30-60 days) may trigger a suspicious transaction report, resignation of the registered agent, and loss of the registered office; the Registrar may thereafter strike off the corporation for failure to maintain a resident agent, and the agent is separately exposed to civil penalties under the MLPA for deficient CDD records.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Statutory Register Audit and Minute Book Verification (Register of Members, Register of Directors, and corporate minute book)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registered agent and company secretary performing the annual corporate secretarial review; the Registrar of Corporations retains inspection authority over books and records upon demand under the Business Corporations Act
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Performed concurrently with the Annual Report cycle and completed on or before June 1 each year; the Register of Members must additionally be updated contemporaneously with every share transfer occurring during the year.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Inaccurate or incomplete statutory registers deprive the register of evidentiary weight, expose directors to liability for breach of record-keeping duties, and impair issuance of the Registrar's certificate of good standing; sustained non-maintenance is an independent ground for administrative dissolution.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No compulsory statutory audit applies to a private, non-listed Marshall Islands Business Corporation. A mandatory independent audit is triggered only if the corporation lists securities on an exchange, holds a regulated financial services license (banking, insurance, or trust business), or is required by its articles, a sectoral regulator, or a foreign revenue authority. The subject cosplay-prop and apparel manufacturing entity (online retail via Stripe and Shopify Payments) does not satisfy any such threshold.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: The Business Corporations Act requires correct and complete books and records of account but prescribes no national GAAP or IFRS conversion mandate for private non-resident domestic corporations. IFRS is the customary reporting framework; US GAAP may be adopted where banking and US payment-rail reporting is involved. Financial statements are not filed with the Registrar or the Marshall Islands tax administration; no income-tax or business-license filings apply to this Tax-Exempt Zone entity.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The Marshall Islands maintains no public UBO register. The licensed registered agent conducts AML/CFT due diligence under the MLPA and Banking Regulations and holds a non-public beneficial ownership file identifying every natural person with a 25% or greater ownership or voting interest. Every share transfer must be documented by executed transfer instruments and board consent and promptly notified to the agent, which updates the UBO file immediately upon any change creating a new 25%+ owner and in all cases obtains a signed annual UBO confirmation as part of the annual report cycle, even when no ownership change occurred. The corporation must respond within the agent's stated deadline (normally 30 days) to preserve good standing.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members, Register of Directors, Minute Book

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 600 – USD 1,500 per annum for a licensed Marshall Islands registered agent and registered office, inclusive of annual report preparation and the UBO/AML refresh; comprehensive corporate-secretarial packages (minute book administration, regulatory correspondence, issuance of certificates) range from USD 1,500 to USD 3,000 per annum.
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: No statutory audit is required; where payment processors, acquirers, or a future shareholder impose a voluntary external audit or agreed-upon procedures engagement for a small manufacturing and direct-to-consumer retail operation, the market fee normally ranges from USD 8,000 to USD 25,000 per engagement.

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% for wholly foreign-source business income; the Republic of the Marshall Islands (RMI) imposes no corporate income tax, capital gains tax, or undistributed profits tax. The Income Tax Act (54 MIRC) purports to tax only gross income derived from sources within the RMI; an NRDC engaged in offshore cosplay apparel manufacturing has no RMI-source income and therefore no tax liability.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Non-Resident Domestic Corporation (NRDC) regime: flat annual license fee of USD 75 (for authorized capital of USD 10,000 or less) paid through a licensed Registered Agent; exemption from the domestic-corporation annual report; no VAT, GST, payroll tax, social security levy, property tax, capital duty, or stamp duty on the manufacturing/export business.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: No corporate income tax return exists in the RMI. The sole mandatory periodic instrument is the 'Annual License Fee Renewal' administered by the Registrar of Corporations (Business Registry Division) and transacted exclusively through a licensed RMI Registered Agent; the RMI does not operate a public e-filing portal for CIT.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due no later than the last day of the month in which the anniversary of incorporation falls; the Registered Agent remits the fee to the Registrar with the annual roster of non-resident entities.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Licensed Registered Agent identification (name and RMI agent license number).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The agent files the renewal on behalf of the NRDC; no direct shareholder action is required.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Corporate legal name and Registrar file number (MC- prefix).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Name must exactly match the Certificate of Incorporation; a change of name requires special resolution and Registrar approval before renewal.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: NRDC status acknowledgment and declaration that no business is carried on within the RMI.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Select the 'Non-Resident Domestic Corporation' classification; do not mark tax-resident or RMI business activity boxes.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered office address in Majuro and registered agent acceptance signature.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A physical address (not a P.O. Box alone) is required; the entity may use the agent's street address.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Current directors and officers roster (full names and service addresses).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Roster is kept by the agent for AML/beneficial-ownership purposes; NRDCs are exempt from filing the annual report with the Registrar, but the roster must be updated on any change.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Authorized capital declaration and fee computation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Standard NRDC annual government fee: USD 75.00; no capital duty is payable on issuance or transfer of shares.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Payment reference and good-standing certificate request.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Obtain the Certificate of Good Standing after payment; foreign banks require this certificate for account maintenance.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late payment attracts a statutory surcharge of 10% of the unpaid annual license fee; if fees remain unpaid for three months after the due date, the Registrar may dissolve the company by proclamation. Trading after dissolution is a criminal/civil offense; reinstatement within three years is possible upon payment of all arrears, the 10% surcharge, and the reinstatement fee.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Economic Substance Regulations 2019 (ESR 2019) - Annual Economic Substance Return / Notification submitted through the Registered Agent on the Registrar's ESR system; no public portal.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual (within 12 months after the end of each financial year of the relevant entity).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: The return is due no later than 12 months after the financial year-end; a separate notification may be due where the entity is tax-resident in a qualifying foreign jurisdiction.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration of 'relevant entity' status and financial year-end date.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: An NRDC whose parent/owner is tax-resident in a State outside the EU blacklist may apply the 'excluded entity' route by certifying the tax residence and submitting the foreign tax residency certificate.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Identification of each 'relevant activity' (manufacturing is not listed; distribution and service centre, headquarters, financing and leasing, holding entity, and IP business are).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For cosplay costume manufacturing conducted offshore, typically 'not applicable'; if the company also distributes goods or holds IP licenses, the relevant activity box must be marked.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Core income-generating activities (CIGAs) location, premises, employees, and board meeting records.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If a relevant activity exists, management and control must be exercised in the RMI (or a qualifying foreign jurisdiction) with adequate physical substance.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Income and expenditure profile by category, including royalty, distribution, and interest flows.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Royalty or commission flows to/from affiliated entities should be supported by contracts and true economic activity at the foreign operating plant.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Self-assessment of compliance and signed declaration by a director or the registered agent.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Deliberate misdeclaration of CIGA location or employees triggers the higher penalty tier (USD 20,000).

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Failure to satisfy the economic substance test: administrative penalty up to USD 10,000 per relevant entity; filing false or misleading information: up to USD 20,000; continued failure may lead to strike-off and exchange of information with treaty partners.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% - the RMI does not impose withholding tax on dividends (or any other distribution), and no approval, clearance, or stamp duty is required before a non-resident shareholder receives a dividend.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Not applicable - the RMI has no double tax agreement network. The only transparency instruments are Tax Information Exchange Agreements (notably with the United States). A shareholder seeking credit in its home state must obtain an RMI Certificate of Good Standing, a certified extract of the share register, and board minutes declaring the dividend; if the home jurisdiction requires a tax residence certificate, the RMI cannot issue such a certificate because the NRDC is not an RMI tax resident in substance.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory rates: 0% for royalties and 0% for interest paid to non-residents; no treaty reductions are needed. Practical caution: the home jurisdiction of the licensor/lender may tax the receipt, and RMI ESR 2019 recharacterizes royalty income received from affiliated parties as an 'IP business' relevant activity if the company holds, exploits, or licenses the intangible.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: None - the RMI has not enacted transfer pricing, Local File, Master File, or country-by-country reporting legislation, and no monetary threshold exists in RMI law (USD is the official currency). Multinational groups must nonetheless apply the parent jurisdiction's TP rules (e.g., US IRC 482/6662(e), OECD TP Guidelines) and should keep contemporaneous arm's length documentation for the NRDC's intercompany sales, royalty, and cost-sharing arrangements.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: The ESR 2019 applies to every 'relevant entity' (including NRDCs) carrying on 'relevant activities'. Pure offshore manufacturing of cosplay apparel/wigs (ISIC 3240) is not a relevant activity, but a company that also (i) distributes goods from inventories, (ii) operates as a service center, (iii) provides financing/leasing to affiliates, or (iv) owns and licenses IP rights in its costume designs must demonstrate adequate employees, premises, expenditure, and CIGA management in the RMI, or prove tax residence in a qualifying foreign jurisdiction. Annual ESR self-assessment returns are mandatory even where no relevant activity is identified.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Corporate Registry Default / Unauthorized Trading After Strike-Off
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Non-payment of the USD 75 annual license fee by the end of the anniversary month; continuing to invoice customers, sign contracts, open bank accounts, or process Stripe/Shopify payments after the Registrar has dissolved the company.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: 10% statutory surcharge on the unpaid fee; dissolution by proclamation after three months of arrears; contracts of the dissolved company are void; the Registrar's Certificate of Dissolution freezes the merchant accounts and banking relationships.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and shareholders transacting in the name of a dissolved company are jointly and severally liable for all obligations so incurred; the High Court may order civil restitution, asset tracing, and freezing orders against directors who continue operations.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Misrepresenting the RMI entity as a substantive manufacturer while all production, warehousing, pricing, and decision-making occur offshore; failing to file the annual ESR return; or declaring the company a pure IP box to strip income out of operating jurisdictions without RMI or foreign substance.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: ESR 2019 penalties: up to USD 10,000 for failing the economic substance test; up to USD 20,000 for false or misleading information; the Registrar may strike off the company, revoke the NRDC exemption, and exchange the corporate records with foreign tax authorities under the TIEA.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors may be disqualified from serving on any RMI company; if the structure is used to mislead foreign revenue authorities, directors face civil restitution, travel bans, and extradition on tax-fraud charges at the request of treaty partners.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: AML-CFT / Money Laundering and Sanctions Evasion
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Routing cosplay apparel proceeds through Stripe/Shopify Payments while the registered agent's beneficial-ownership file is empty or inaccurate; commingling personal expenses with corporate receivables; transacting with sanctioned buyers or jurisdictions; unreported cash or crypto conversion.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Prosecution under the RMI AML/CFT Act 2022 and the Crimes Act 2012; penalties include substantial criminal fines, asset-freezing orders by the RMI Financial Intelligence Unit, confiscation of the corporate bank balance, and forced deregistration; card-acquirer termination notices are customary.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and officers knowingly benefiting from tainted receipts are subject to criminal prosecution, civil forfeiture of personal assets, imprisonment (including custodial sentences prescribed by the RMI Criminal Code), travel bans, and extradition to the requesting state.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Transforming Chinese or Southeast Asian manufacturing income into tax-exempt 'commission manufacturing' or 'royalty' income under the RMI shell without realigned contracts, substance, or business purpose; preparing false invoices or TP documentation for foreign tax audits; establishing the NRDC solely to evade home country CFC/GILTI rules.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The RMI imposes no domestic income tax, so the evasion charge is prosecuted in the market jurisdiction (e.g., US IRC 7201/7206, UK Criminal Finances Act, EU DAC-6 penalties); the RMI TIEA commitment authorizes exchange of corporate records, and the Registrar may void the structure as contrary to public policy.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who design or sign the offending arrangements may be pursued as enablers and liable for disgorgement of profits, foreign criminal fines and imprisonment, permanent director disqualification, and enforcement of foreign restitution orders through the RMI High Court.
